title: Txt == "" matches the empty-string row only
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( Empty, Empty[Txt] == "" ) ) )

source.quote: Returns TRUE if Product[Color] is an empty string, returns FALSE if it is BLANK or any other value
source.supports: Column == "" is TRUE only for the empty string

derivation: Empty[Txt] holds '' (Id 1), BLANK (Id 2), x (Id 3). == is TRUE for the empty string and FALSE for BLANK, so only row 1 matches: 1 row.
